dialogues.speaker: Bayajidda
dialogues.text: I'm a volunteer at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. When the competition's on, I'm responsible for maintaining order inside, guiding contestants to where they should be, and so on.

dialogues.speaker: Bayajidda
dialogues.text: I also wander around between matches to see if anyone needs help.

dialogues.speaker: Bayajidda
dialogues.text: Anyway, things have been a bit quiet lately, so if you need any help at all, don't hesitate to let me know!

dialogues.speaker: Bayajidda
dialogues.text: Oh, and if you'd like to join our team of volunteers, just say the word and it shall be so!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need it at the moment, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll swing by when I'm free.

dialogues.speaker: Bayajidda
dialogues.text: Enjoying exciting competitions as a volunteer is also a great experience.
